changelog:
- YouTube Blank Screen & Buffering Resolved: Manifest streams pass without delay; ad breaks stripped in-place via Response.prototype.json (uBlock Origin standard).
- ABP-Style Network Filtering: Added full support for ||host^ domain anchors, @@ exception rules, and path-scoped rules with boundary matching (e.g. ||facebook.com^tr blocks tracking pixels without breaking login).
- Enhanced Social Ad Blocking: Hardened network rules for Reddit, TikTok, Snapchat, and LinkedIn ad endpoints.
- Pure Android System WebView v2.1.8 release (17.4 MB).
